doc.title: Herb Ellis interviewed by Michael Woods, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995 [interview 1 of 2]

chapter: Pay, health and the Gibson guitar
title: Life and health now
summary: Ellis says he is blessed with good health, plays about half the time, and would play regardless of money.

story.theme_name: Still working: current gigs, upcoming projects and plans
story.community_name: What's next: upcoming tours, records and plans

blocks.x: Describe how things are for you now. © Fillius Jazz Archive -7-

They are very good. There is something to be said for playing as long as I have. You know I’m very blessed. The Lord has blessed me. I don’t have arthritis and my health is good, so I play about half the time now. And even if I didn’t have to play financially I’d still play because I love it. It’s what I do. It keeps me young, or thinking I’m young anyway.
